purpose: Under the new 11th gate (#11 strict LOSO unknown rejection > 0.90), re-search the open-set gate system: implement loso_std (E143 protocol, the held-out identity participates in the task-wise z statistics and the PCA basis) and loso_strict (the held-out identity is excluded from those statistics as well as from the prototypes), score every reusable gate candidate on both readings and on the Test S1 / S2 audit, locate the loso_strict vs Test-min Pareto frontier, and answer whether #11 can coexist with Test S1 >= 0.70 AND Test S2 >= 0.70 in one work point.

protocol.blocks_rule: block = clip(int(frac * 5), 0, 4) per (subject, task) trial order

loso_definitions.loso_std: E143 protocol: task-wise mean/std from every Train row of the task (all 20 identities, the held-out identity included), PCA basis fitted on fit_rows of all 20 identities, prototypes from pm & fit_rows only (19 enrolled identities).
loso_definitions.loso_strict: For held identity h: task-wise mean/std from the other 19 identities' Train rows only, PCA basis from (keep & fit_rows) only, prototypes from (keep & fit_rows) only. No row of h enters any fitted statistic.
loso_definitions.evaluation: known = 19 enrolled identities' 0.6 < frac <= 0.8 rows; unknown = h's same window; per-fold threshold = quantile(fold known, 1 - a); 20 folds.

wccn_dr.path: E192 WCCN distance-ratio gate on E65 correlation-logSPD

deployment.distance_streams: E143 / E194 convention: per-task z statistics from all Train rows, PCA basis from all Train fit_rows, Test and 5-block OOF prototypes from every Train row (~block for OOF), LOSO folds from pm & fit_rows only.
deployment.wccn_dr: E192 convention: WCCN fitted on fit_rows, prototypes from every class, 5-block OOF fitted on fit_rows & ~block; strict folds fitted on the other 19 identities' fit_rows.
deployment.e183_fuse: published E183 cache; no 5-block OOF stream, threshold = pooled strict LOSO known quantile (E194 convention).

candidates.weight_rule: Fusion weights are selected on LOSO strict only (max strict rejection at a=0.90, tie-break strict pooled AUC). Test is never used for weight selection. The Pareto audit additionally reports every weight on the grid so the frontier can be seen; that audit is not a deployable selector.

attack.type: self-built white-box PGD on the E191 branch-A v3 identity model
attack.subset: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, stratified cap 400 per task, seed 20261115 (E180/E189/E191 subset)
attack.radius: per-trial L2 norm of the channel-demeaned waveform divided by 10^(SNR/20)
attack.reading: #7 = min RA over SNR x goal; #8 = min ASafeR over the same conditions

gates.5: pseudo-unknown LOSO AUROC >= 0.98 (strict reading reported; std alongside)
gates.7: RA worst over SNR x goal >= 0.95
gates.8: ASafeR worst over the same conditions >= 0.98
gates.11: loso_strict unknown rejection at a=0.90 > 0.90 (loso_std reported alongside)
gates.criterion_note: user criterion: S1 >= 0.70 AND S2 >= 0.70 in the same work point; #11 uses the strict reading

reporting.test_official: N/A - Test has no identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: all Test scores are computed before the Session column is read; Session only splits S1 / S2 for the #9/#10 audit
reporting.single_work_point: every counted column is one candidate at a=0.90; nothing is spliced across work points

threshold_rules.paired_loso: tau = quantile of the concatenated paired per-fold known scores (same rows for every fused component); available for every candidate, used for the uniform Pareto comparison
threshold_rules.oof: tau = quantile of the 5-block OOF score (project convention, E189/E191); available for distance / WCCN streams only, reported alongside
threshold_rules.e183: E183 has no 5-block OOF stream in its published cache; its published threshold is the pooled strict LOSO known quantile (E194 used the same)
